color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Email + password. Two roles:
superadmin sees all screens,
screenowner sees only their own.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
The operator does every step:
upload the ad, pick the screen,
set the dates, book it.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Just describe the campaign in words.
Runs on Google GEMINI 2.5 FLASH.
The AGENT decides what to do; the TOOLS do it —
find the screen, list your ads,
check the ad fits that screen's size.
It never saves on its own — you confirm.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
A partner platform books on our screens
with a key + secret. Secret is shown once.
Every booking is tagged back to them.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
One engine for all three lanes:
check it is allowed, save it,
flag the screen to reload.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
THE HEARTBEAT — every 60 s the screen checks in:
I am alive, here is what I am playing, anything new?
Yes → pull the new playlist and play it.
The same beat also delivers screenshot requests.
No live push, so it scales to any fleet size.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
PROOF IS A SEPARATE CHANNEL — NOT THE HEARTBEAT
Heartbeat = the 60 s check-in above.
Proof = its own upload, ~60 s, 200 plays at a time.
Offline screens keep playing and send later — nothing is lost.
Every play is signed on the device, so it cannot be faked.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Two kinds, one pipeline:
3 AUTOMATIC shots per campaign — start, middle, end — kept forever.
CAPTURE NOW — click any time and the screen photographs
your ad on its next real play.
Never black, never the wrong ad: the shutter only fires
while your ad is actually on the glass.

div.style: color: rgb(58, 74, 90) !important; font-size: 13px !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 800px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Freeze = one final total per campaign = the bill.
Delete = 30 DAYS LATER the raw play records go.
Keep = the 3 proof screenshots stay forever.
